###alb
```{r}
#combining all dstatistics and metadata for Q. alb
library(dplyr)
library(plyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
meta_pop<-read.delim("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_DSuite_MACREF/Pops.txt")

Dalb_All<-data.frame(pop=character(),chr=character(),windowStart=integer(),windowEnd=integer(),D=double(),f_d=double(),f_dM=double(),d_f=double(),lat=double(),long=double(),windowmid=integer())

for(i in 1:length(meta_pop$Pop)){
  pop<-meta_pop$Pop[i]
  lat<-meta_pop$latitude.orig[i]
  long<-meta_pop$longitude.orig[i]
  if(file.exists(paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/bicolor_macrocarpa_",pop,"_alba_localFstats__2000_1000.txt",sep=""))){
    Dalb_pop<-subset(read.delim(paste("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/bicolor_macrocarpa_",pop,"_alba_localFstats__2000_1000.txt",sep="")),chr=="Chr01"|chr=="Chr02"|chr=="Chr03"|chr=="Chr04"|chr=="Chr05"|chr=="Chr06"|chr=="Chr07"|chr=="Chr08"|chr=="Chr09"|chr=="Chr10"|chr=="Chr11"|chr=="Chr12")
    Dalb_pop<-Dalb_pop[seq_len(nrow(Dalb_pop)) %% 2 == 0, ]
    Dalb_pop$pop<-rep(pop,length(Dalb_pop$chr))
    Dalb_pop$lat<-rep(lat,length(Dalb_pop$chr))
    Dalb_pop$long<-rep(long,length(Dalb_pop$chr))
    Dalb_pop$windowmid<-round_any(rowMeans(Dalb_pop[,2:3]),500000)
    Dalb_All<-rbind(Dalb_All,Dalb_pop)
  }
  #Dalb_pop$Loc<-paste(Dalb_pop$CHROM,Dalb_pop$BIN_START,sep="_")
  
}
Dalb_All$chr2<-Dalb_All$chr
Dalb_All<-Dalb_All %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across('chr2',str_replace,'Chr',''))
Dalb_All$chr3<-as.numeric(Dalb_All$chr2)

write.table(Dalb_All,file="C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/bic_mac_alb_2000.txt",row.names=FALSE,quote=FALSE,sep="\t")
#I don't know that window number is the best method

```

Dlob_All$species<-rep("lob",length(Dlob_All$chr))

Dalb_All$species<-rep("alb",length(Dalb_All$chr))

Dste_All$species<-rep("ste",length(Dste_All$chr))

# Dbi_All<-Dbi_All %>%
#   dplyr::mutate(across('chr2',str_replace,'Chr',''))
# Dbi_All$chr3<-as.numeric(Dbi_All$chr2)

##for 500,000 bp windows, saiving the max d_f for each population (this helps with visualizing)

Dsp_All<-data.frame(pop=character(),chr=character(),windowStart=integer(),windowEnd=integer(),D=double(),f_d=double(),f_dM=double(),d_f=double(),lat=double(),long=double(),windowmid=integer(),species=character(),chr2=character(),chr3=integer())
for(j in 1:12){
  i=min(D_All$windowmid)
  while(i <= max(D_All$windowmid)){
    if(i %in% subset(Dbi_All,chr3==j)$windowmid){
      Dwind<-rbind(subset(Dalb_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dbi_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dlob_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dly_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dmue_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j),subset(Dste_All,windowmid==i&chr3==j))
      Dsp_All<-rbind(Dsp_All,(Dwind %>% group_by(pop) %>% top_n(1, d_f)))
    }
    i=i+500000
  }
}

write.table(Dsp_All,file="C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/Dsp2000Max5E5_mac.txt",row.names=FALSE,quote=FALSE,sep="\t")

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
pops<-read_excel("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_METADATA/metadata_pops.xlsx",sheet="metadata_pops")
Dlob_All<-read.delim("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/107_Dsuite_MACREF/DPOPS/bic_mac_lob_2000.txt",sep="\t")
Dlob_All$species<-rep("lob",length(Dlob_All$chr))

library(dplyr)
Dlob_All_win<-Dlob_All %>% group_by(pop,windowmid,chr) %>% top_n(1, d_f)
Dlob_All_sigwins<-subset(Dlob_All_win,d_f>0.25)
Dlob_All_sigwins$count<-1
Dlob_All_countsigwins<-aggregate(count~pop+lat,data=Dlob_All_sigwins,FUN=sum)
Dlob_All_countsigwins<-merge(Dlob_All_countsigwins,pops,by.x = "pop",by.y="Pop")
#merge distance to range edge
samps_edge_dist<-read.delim("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/00_Scripts_and_Labels/00_METADATA/dist_range_margin_centroid.txt",sep="\t")

Dlob_All_win_edge<-merge(Dlob_All_countsigwins,samps_edge_dist,by.x="pop",by.y="Pop",all.x=T)
#do regression
lob_distcent<-ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(formula = Dlob_All_win_edge$d_f~Dlob_All_win_edge$dist_fromCenter_EM,color="black")+
  geom_point(mapping=aes(y = Dlob_All_win_edge$count, x=Dlob_All_win_edge$dist_fromCenter_EM,shape=Dlob_All_win_edge$MacPop, color=Dlob_All_win_edge$lat))+
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "latitude")+
  labs(x="distance from centroid",y="windows",subtitle="Q. lobata")+
  theme_light()

lob_distedge<-ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(formula = Dlob_All_win_edge$d_f~Dlob_All_win_edge$dist_fromEdge)+
  geom_jitter(mapping=aes(y = Dlob_All_win_edge$count, x=Dlob_All_win_edge$dist_fromEdge, shape=Dste_All_win_edge$MacPop, color=Dlob_All_win_edge$lat))+
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "latitude")+
  labs(x="distance from edge",y="windows",subtitle="Q. lobata")+
  theme_light()

lob_lat<-ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(method=lm,mapping=aes(y = Dlob_All_win_edge$count, x=Dlob_All_win_edge$lat))+
  geom_jitter(mapping=aes(y = Dlob_All_win_edge$count, x=Dlob_All_win_edge$lat, shape=Dlob_All_win_edge$lob))+
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "latitude")+
  labs(x="latitude",y="windows")+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(n=4,y=16))+
  theme_light()


##PCA
Dlob_All_win$chr_win<-paste(Dlob_All_win$chr,Dlob_All_win$windowmid,sep="_")
Dlob_All_win_small<-Dlob_All_win[,-c(1:6,9:14)]

library(tidyr)
Dlob_All_win_wide<-pivot_wider(Dlob_All_win_small,names_from=chr_win,values_from=d_f)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data=Dlob_PCs)+
